verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਬਿਬਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਕਰਤ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਨਾਰਿ ਭੇਟਤ ਭਤਾਰ ਉਰ ਹਾਰ ਨ ਸੁਹਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise bibidh prakaar karat si(n)gaar naar bheTat bhataar ur haar na suhaat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a wife makes over many type of embellishments in order to attract her husband, but once in the embrace of her husband, she does not like even the necklace in her neck.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਲਕ ਅਚੇਤ ਜੈਸੇ ਕਰਤ ਅਨੇਕ ਲੀਲਾ ਸੁਰਤ ਸਮਾਰ ਬਾਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਸਰਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: baalak achet jaise karat anek leelaa surat samaar baal budh bisaraat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as an innocent child plays many types of games as a child, but as soon as he grows up, he forgets all his childhood preoccupations.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਸੰਗਮ ਸੁਜਸ ਨਾਇਕਾ ਬਖਾਨੈ ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਸਜਨੀ ਸਕਲ ਬਿਗਸਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise pirayaa sa(n)gam sujas naikaa bakhaanai sun sun sajanee sakal bigasaat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a wife praises before her friends the meeting that she had with her husband and her friends feel happy listening to her details.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਖਟ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਸ੍ਰਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਕਾਜ ਗਿਆਨ ਭਾਨ ਉਦੈ ਉਡ ਕਰਮ ਉੇਡਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੬੦੪॥
verses.translit_en: taise khaT karam dharam sram giaan kaaj giaan bhaan udhai udd karam ueddaat hai ||604||

en.bdb: Similarly, the six righteous deeds performed so laboriously for acquisition of knowledge, all of them disappear with the radiance of Guru's teachings and Naam like the stars disappear with the brightness of the Sun.
